warnings: *** THE TWO TREAD DETAILS GIVE DIFFERENT BOARD WIDTHS AND BOTH ARE REAL. *** แบบขยายจมูกบันได specifies ลูกนอนไม้แดง 1 1/2"x3" while แบบขยายลูกนอน specifies ลูกนอนไม้แดง 1 1/2"x10". They are not a contradiction: the 3-inch piece is the nosing strip at the front edge of a tread finished in parquet, and the 10-inch piece is a solid-board tread. Both are drawn on the same sheet at the same scale, so the set offers two tread build-ups. Recorded as two separate elements rather than merged or reconciled.
The three 1:5 details share one scale and one subject (the staircase) and are recorded as one section file; splitting them further would create three files with one element each.
10 มม. chamfer (ลบมุม) is printed on both tread details and 0.01 m appears as a dimension beside each - the same value written two ways on one sheet.
